verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents QoS settings explicitly for handling non-ideal networks, including reliability tuning and transient-local durability, plus rosbag recording to persist topic data locally. A user also confirms data bagging comes 'for free'. These are the product's own capabilities for local operation and on-robot data capture, but nothing documents cloud-disconnect handling, store-and-forward upload, or clean resync after connectivity returns. missing for 10: documented offline/cloud-disconnect operation mode, store-and-forward buffering with automatic upload on reconnect, documented recovery/resync behavior, hands-on corroboration in fleet deployments
